# Liberation Sans Narrow 1.07.4

Bundled as the app font (`app/src/main/res/font/app_font_regular.ttf` and
`app_font_bold.ttf`). It is a free, metric-compatible substitute for Arial
Narrow (same character widths), with full Romanian diacritics.

Source: https://releases.pagure.org/liberation-fonts/liberation-fonts-ttf-1.07.4.tar.gz
License: GNU GPL v2 with font exception (see `License.txt`, `COPYING`).
